headline: Milei Warns Against Relaxing Monetary Policy at Argentine Rural Society
summary: Argentine President Javier Milei spoke before the Argentine Rural Society, warning that relaxing monetary policy would be like throwing gasoline on a fire while praising entrepreneurs as wealth creators.
why: Presidential statements on monetary stance provide critical guidance on central bank independence and macroeconomic stabilization paths.
